title: REQ · Story panel with intro screen, dialogue, choices, history and inventory
summary: Story panel shows intro copy, dialogue choices, history and inventory
description: Context: game/src/systems/dialogue.ts exposes getActiveNode and chooseOption; state has history and inventory. Desired behavior: IntroScreen shows the suggested intro copy with a Begin button; StoryPanel shows the active dialogue node, choice buttons, scrollable history and inventory summary. Expected result: choosing a dialogue option advances story and logs history. Why: narrative interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given empty history, When App opens, Then intro copy 'You decide.' is visible
Given an active node, When StoryPanel renders, Then speaker, text and one button per choice show
Given a choice click, When pressed, Then onChoose is called with its index
Given inventory items, When rendered, Then each item name is listed, else 'Empty'

out_of_scope: Contribution form and 'Suggest What Happens Next' flow
preserve: game/src/** engine, systems and state modules unchanged

technical_constraints: Reuse game/src runtime via imports; do not copy it
definition_of_done: Acceptance criteria demonstrated by unit tests
